verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI documents first-party MCP support: configuring MCP servers in ~/.gemini/settings.json to extend it with custom tools, using MCP servers for capabilities like Imagen/Veo/Lyria, and docs describing a ReAct loop that uses built-in tools plus local/remote MCP servers. Community examples show real invocation of MCP-connected tools (@github, @slack, @database). Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the MCP setup workflow itself (most community commentary focuses on coding quality, not MCP integration specifics).
